{{Quote|We are getting no signal from the Republic, Your Highness.''"<br />"''I don't see anything. It is not like the Jedi to be late.|The guard and Katuunko|<ref name="Ambush">{{TCW|Ambush}}</ref>}}
'''This [[Toydarian royal guard]]''' was present during the [[Battle of Rugosa/Legends|Mission to Rugosa]] and was assigned to protect [[King/Legends|King]] [[Katuunko/Legends|Katuunko]].

==Biography==
When the [[Toydarian royal delegation/Legends|Toydarian royal delegation]] and [[King/Legends|King]] [[Katuunko/Legends|Katuunko]] arrived on [[Rugosa/Legends|Rugosa]] for [[Battle of Rugosa/Legends|negotiations]] with the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]], this guard was surprised to find that they were getting no signal from the Republic consultation party. Soon, [[Asajj Ventress/Legends|Asajj Ventress]] appeared with [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droid]] guards. They and their fellow guard feared Ventress posed a threat, so they raised their blasters. However, Katuunko wasn't worried at all. When Ventress was ordered to [[Death/Legends|kill]] the king after he chose to join the Republic, the two guards tried to defend him, but Ventress merely [[Telekinesis/Legends#Applications|Force pushed]] them, subsequently knocking them unconscious. They soon awoke to find Ventress gone, and joined [[Yoda/Legends|Yoda]], [[Clone trooper/Legends|his troops]], and Katuunko in boarding a [[Low Altitude Assault Transport/Legends|Republic gunship]] with a new alliance.
